Exam Date & Time: 12-Aug-2022 (10:00 AM - 01:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  SECOND SEMESTER B.TECH. EXAMINATIONS (MIT MANIPAL) - AUGUST 2022  
  SUBJECT : ECE 1051 - BASIC ELECTRONICS  
  (MAKEUP)  
  BASIC ELECTRONICS [ECE 1051]  
Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
1A)          A particular load has to be supplied with average voltage of 5V. Find the value of  
  capacitance and transformer turns ratio in a full wave rectifier with capacitor filter such (4)  
  that the ripple factor should not exceed 1%. Assume 220V rms, 50Hz supply voltage.  
  
1B)           For a silicon diode, the reverse saturation current is 40nA at 200C. If the diode is  
  forward biased with 0.7V, determine the i) static resistance at 200C ii) dynamic            (3)  
  resistance at 200C.  
  
1C)           In a Zener voltage regulator circuit, Vz=12V, Rs=1KΩ, RL= 2 KΩ, input voltage ranges  
  from 15V to 25V. Find (a)IL (b) PZ(max).                                             (3)  
  
2A)           Draw the circuit of RC Coupled amplifier and explain the need for connecting bypass  
  capacitor in RC Coupled amplifier. If three RC Coupled amplifiers are cascaded  
  together with an individual voltage gain of 20dB, find the output voltage of second and     (4)  
  third amplifier for an input voltage of 5mV given to the first amplifier.  
  
2B)           For the circuit shown in the Fig.Q2B, sketch the output characteristics and mark the  
  operating point. Assume β=100, Silicon transistor.  
  
  
  (3)  
  
  
2C)           In a bridge rectifier circuit, if the peak voltage appearing across the secondary winding  
  of the transformer is 10V, find the (i) DC output Voltage (ii) RMS output voltage.          (3)  
  Assume ideal diodes.  
  
3A)           Write the truth table of full adder and obtain the simplified expressions for sum and  
  carry using k-map. Realize using Basic gates (AND, OR, NOT).                                (4)  
  
3B)                                                                                                       (3)

$$Realize the equation VOUT =-3V1-2V2-0.5V3 using an OP-AMP, where V1, V2, V3 are$$  
  the input voltages and VOUT is the output voltage. Draw the circuit diagram.  
  
3C)             Define the input offset voltage of an OP-AMP. Mention its ideal value. For the circuit  
  shown in Fig.Q3C, find the output voltage.  
  
  
  (3)  
  
  
4A)             A logic circuit that has 3-inputs A, B, C which provides output '1' when two or more  
  input variables are '1'. Obtain a simplified expression for the system using K-map and   (4)  
  implement using-only NAND gates.  
  
4B)             Perform (24.625)10 - (42.75)10 using two's complement method.  
  (3)  
  
4C)             Generate (7, 4) Hamming code for the binary data '1011'. Also, write the gray code  
  representation for the same binary data '1011'.                                          (3)  
  
5A)             An audio signal 10sin(2𝜋500𝑡) is used to amplitude modulate a carrier of 50sin(2𝜋105𝑡).  
  Calculate the (i) Modulation index (ii) Bandwidth required for transmission (iii) Side  (4)  
  band frequencies (iv) Side band amplitudes.  
  
$$5B)             Given a FM equation, VFM (t) =5cos[2\pi 108t +5sin(2\pi 104t)], Calculate (i) Carrier signal$$  
  frequency and Modulating signal frequency (ii) Frequency deviation (iii)Bandwidth      (3)  
  using Carson's rule.  
  
5C)             Sketch the ASK, FSK and PSK signals for the 6-bit binary data '101101'.  
  (3)
